question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party and People's Liberation Army as of mid-2026, with recent military purges and elite reshuffles appearing to consolidate rather than undermine his authority ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Term limits were eliminated in 2018, enabling extended rule, and no designated successor has emerged to signal an imminent transition. Trader consensus on continuity reflects the absence of visible factional challenges, public dissent, or institutional mechanisms capable of forcing removal before 2027. Realistic scenarios that could still shift outcomes include sudden health events, major foreign policy reversals, or internal elite realignments, though none show signs of materializing in the near term.
